newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia says no wish to interfere in Sudan.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia says no wish to interfere in Sudan.

text.p: Foreign Minister Seyoum Mesfin said on Monday Ethiopia had no desire to destabilise or promote confrontation in Sudan but Khartoum's foreign policy was "insane".

"Ethiopia has no time for destructive activities. War- mongering, interfering in the internal affairs of others and being at loggerheads with neighours have no place in our foreign policy agenda," Seyoum told diplomats in the Ethiopian capital.
"Ethiopia would benefit absolutely nothing from continuing turmoil in the Sudan," added Seyoum, who however said chances for cooperation were undermined by Khartoum's "insane" foreign policy.
Ethiopian Prime Minister Meles Zenawi on Thursday ruled out the possibility of war with neighbouring Sudan despite charges of aggression from Khartoum's Islamist-backed government.

Sudan has accused Ethiopia, Eritrea and Uganda of direct military involvement in an offensive launched a month ago from the south and east by rebel Sudan People's Liberation Army and allied opposition forces.

Relations between Khartoum and Addis Ababa have been chilly since Ethiopia accused Sudan of harbouring gunmen who attempted to assassinate Egypt's President Hosni Mubarak in the Ethiopian capital in 1995.
